name: NIC Sikkim State Data Centre (Gangtok)
developer: National Informatics Centre (NIC) / Government of Sikkim
notes: State e-governance data centre operated by NIC in Gangtok supporting Sikkim e-Governance initiatives; government/state DC, not commercial colocation.

name: AdaniConneX Chennai 1 (SIPCOT IT Park, Siruseri)
notes: Phase 1 17 MW IT load live (opened Nov 2022), scales to 33 MW at full buildout; IGBC Platinum pre-certified; SIPCOT IT Park Siruseri is in Chengalpattu district.

name: Sify Infinit Spaces Chennai 02 AI-ready hyperscale campus (Siruseri)
notes: Phase 1 (25.92 MW IT power) inaugurated by CM Stalin Apr 2025; campus planned 130 MW with on-site cable landing station; described as South India's largest AI-ready DC campus.

name: Equinix CN1 (SIPCOT IT Park, Siruseri)
notes: First phase opened 2023 (800 cabinets, ~USD 69M); 24 MW full buildout on 5.5-acre SIPCOT IT Park parcel; Siruseri is in Chengalpattu district.

name: Techno Digital AI-ready Chennai data centre (Siruseri)
notes: Single trade-magazine claim of a 36 MW AI-ready facility; aggregator (Baxtel) places it at SIPCOT IT Park Siruseri; needs official operator confirmation.

name: Zenlayer MAA1 Chennai (SIPCOT IT Park, Siruseri)
notes: Aggregator-listed edge/network node at SIPCOT IT Park Siruseri; capacity unverified.

name: Digital Connexion MAA10 (Ambattur Industrial Estate)
developer: Digital Connexion (Brookfield / Reliance Industries / Digital Realty JV)
notes: Launched Jan 2024; Phase 1 20 MW critical IT load on 10-acre campus scalable to 100 MW; Ambattur is in Chennai district; DE-CIX PoP established on-site.

name: Iron Mountain CHN-1 / CHN-2 campus (Ambattur)
developer: Iron Mountain Data Centers (incl. former Web Werks assets)
notes: CHN-1 23.2 MW topped out in 2026 and going live; CHN-2 19 MW targeted 2028; 42 MW total campus on 4.3 acres in Ambattur, Chennai.

name: CtrlS Chennai Datacenter Park (Ambattur)
notes: Launched Feb 2025 (Rs 4,000 cr); two buildings, 72 MW IT load, dedicated 230 kV GIS substation (120 MW); Rated-4, ~1M sq ft, Ambattur Industrial Estate.

name: NTT (Netmagic) Chennai 1 & Chennai 2
developer: NTT Global Data Centers / NTT DATA (Netmagic legacy)
notes: Chennai 1 (Thiruverkadu, ~2 MW) and Chennai 2 (Ambattur, ~34 MW) per official NTT page and aggregator listings; combined ~36 MW.

name: STT GDC India Chennai portfolio
notes: Official location page lists multiple Chennai facilities (legacy Tata Communications colocation); per-facility MW not published.

name: Microsoft Azure South India region (Chennai)
notes: Official cloud-region evidence of operational Azure capacity in Chennai metro; region-level evidence, not a specific facility address.

name: PDG Chennai CH1
notes: Aggregator (MLQ) lists 72 MW planned Chennai campus; needs operator/official confirmation.

name: Coimbatore colocation facilities (unnamed operators)
notes: Aggregator lists 3 colocation facilities in Coimbatore; no named commercial hyperscale project verified in trade press; Tier-II market with small colocation presence.
